entities.summary: Votorantim is a city located at the southwest of São Paulo State in Brazil. It is part of the Metropolitan Region of Sorocaba. The population is 123,599. The city is located about 100 km (62 mi) away from the capital of the state. It has 147 km2 (57 mi2) of rural area, 30 km2 (12 mi2) of urban area and a total area of 183.52 km2 (70.86 mi2).
